set -eu
py=/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp/miniconda/bin/python3.12

"$py" - "$receiver" <<'PY'
import collections,hashlib,importlib.machinery,importlib.util,json,sys
path=sys.argv[1]
loader=importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader("delegate_cagent_live",path)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_loader(loader.name,loader)
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.CLAIM_MODEL_SEED==42,m.CLAIM_MODEL_SEED
env={
 "task_id":"cagent-seed-determinism-probe",
 "objective":"Execute the explicitly delegated bounded terminal command to print runtime identity evidence.",
 "allowed_capability_profile":["terminal_exec"],
 "delegation_depth":0,
}
validated={"task_id":"cagent-seed-determinism-probe","tool":"terminal_exec","authority":"bounded_operator"}
decisions=[]; digests=[]
for _ in range(12):
    claim,_=m.claim_task(env,validated,m.CLAIM_MODEL_ID,30.0)
    decisions.append(claim["decision"])
    canonical=json.dumps(claim,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode()
    digests.append(hashlib.sha256(canonical).hexdigest())
counts=dict(collections.Counter(decisions))
assert counts=={"CLAIM":12},counts
assert len(set(digests))==1,digests
print("LIVE_CAGENT_SEEDED_ADMISSION_REPRODUCIBILITY=PASS")
print("IDENTICAL_REQUESTS=12")
print("CLAIM_COUNT=12")
print("DECLINE_COUNT=0")
print("UNIQUE_CLAIM_PAYLOADS=1")
print("CLAIM_MODEL_SEED=42")
print("CLAIM_PAYLOAD_SHA256="+digests[0])
PY
